scope: Theorem 16.5 (Law-level rigidity for the tree model) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 201. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every normalized tree law furnished by Proposition 16.4, and every extraction of one of its controlled families after a change of units with positive limiting internal endpoint norm, the optimal constants in (16.8) satisfy c = C > 0. Almost surely, simultaneously on every open set U, FU = CDU . In particular the metric multiplier is deterministic.
